page.overview:
Who is Bulldog?

Bulldog is the son of Conney and the king of the Sorbet Kingdom. He held the throne one generation before Bekori’s reign, and reclaimed his position after Bekori's successor Bartholomew Kuma became a fugitive.

He was old, wrinkled, and average height, has short grey hair and a small grey beard. He wears a feather blue coat, dark pants, a white V-neck shirt, a pair of brown boots and a white ushanka with yellow edging on the ears. True to his name, he resembles as a bulldog.

Bulldog is a benign and just person who is liked among the elderly citizens of Sorbet Kingdom. He is also wise, as he analyzed and predicted Bekori's moves based on newspaper articles and intel.

As king of the Sorbet Kingdom, Bulldog has authority over all of the citizens. During Kuma's own reign, he trusted Bulldog with running the kingdom due to his experience in political matters.
